scenarioIntro: Philippine crop scenarios for professional and institutional investors, each modeled on an illustrative USD 100,000 allocation. These company-model outcomes are not guaranteed investor returns or subscription terms.
scenarioDescriptions: Modeled around an agarwood harvest in Years 9–10.
Modeled annual mango harvests from Year 5.
Combines different crop maturities to illustrate a more balanced cash-flow profile.
scenarioQualification: Illustrative only—not forecasts, promises or guaranteed returns. Actual outcomes may differ materially and capital may be lost. These Philippine scenarios do not represent Thailand opportunities or fund performance. Investor outcomes depend on the selected structure and definitive documents.
scenarioSource: Source: Golden Forests, Investment Opportunities and Participation Overview, November 2026. Figures reproduced from company scenarios; not independently verified.
scenarioAssumptions: Illustrative allocation: USD 100,000 per scenario. Agarwood uses a 10-year cycle; mango and the combined scenario use 15-year cycles. IRR reflects the timing of modeled cash flows and is not an annual payout.
Timing: agarwood harvests are modeled in Years 9–10; recurring mango harvests begin in Year 5. Actual survival, fruiting, yields, quality and harvest timing may differ.
Pricing: the agarwood model starts at USD 775/kg and the mango model at USD 4.00/kg, each escalating at 3% annually. These are modeling assumptions, not secured sale prices.

Costs: the agarwood model includes reserve funding for inoculation, harvest, extraction and packaging, with a 10% commission on gross harvested income. The mango model deducts packaging, cold storage, export certification, audit and related harvest-period costs, with a 20% commission after applicable deductions.

Outcomes are sensitive to selling prices, operating and processing costs, commissions, taxes, foreign exchange, regulation, export access, counterparty performance and successful third-party sales. Crop proceeds are not automatically shareholder distributions.

Review the full financial models and agronomic, operational, market, legal and tax due diligence before making a decision. Request opportunity-specific materials, subject to eligibility, approval and confidentiality requirements.
